create_alexnet_rotnet_model: create an AlexNetRotNet model trunk with a config and model name for rotation prediction tasks
build_alexnet_rotnet_forward: build a forward pass through the AlexNetRotNet trunk that returns intermediate feature outputs
register_model_trunk_alexnet: register the AlexNetRotNet class as a model trunk under the name alexnet_rotnet
extract_intermediate_features: extract intermediate feature maps from alexnet_rotnet conv and pool layers by specifying out_feat_keys
test_alexnet_rotnet_forward: test the alexnet_rotnet forward method with input tensors and out_feat_keys to verify feature extraction
